_doc: ERA-2 fake TV-evangelist 'testimony' INFOMERCIAL — an interrupt that surfaces after the first Restorify realignment. Dark mirror of TRANSCENDANCE; prototype for its canvas. A real scripted infomercial: a storyline with named composite 'voices' (PASTOR DALE the host, MARCUS a 'graduate', an ANNOUNCER, a CROWD) staged as shots. Satire targets the SELLER's salesmanship ONLY, never queer people / survivors / the composite 'testimony'. Invented ministry/brand/number/people — no real orgs/likenesses/verbatim testimony. Real apparatus echoed (1998 'Truth in Love'; Robert Tilton 'Success-N-Life') documented in docs/ERA2_EVANGELIST_COMMERCIAL_SCRIPT_2026-06-30.md, [VERIFY SOURCE]. REINTERP PORT NOTE (R28-2a session, per ERA_MINING FIND #3 'port it'): copied from the shipped build's data/dialog/s2_media.json. R28-2d-iv (Session 35): the reinterp NetVision Player (src/desktop/apps/netvision.ts) reads this file — repositioned per docs/REINTERP_E2_HOMECOMING_SCRIPT_2026-07-12.md S2R.4 as Lamby's post-relapse recommendation, not a bare interrupt.
_docS51: S51 (2026-07-25) — RETIMED TO THE REAL SONG, per docs/REINTERP_NEW_YOU_VIDEO_SPEC_2026-07-25.md, whose table is authoritative. Sérgio's playthrough #2: 'the video itself is very not related to the content of the song, and also the song doesn't yet play.' Both were the same fault — the old 13 scenes were hand-written PARAPHRASES on invented timings across a made-up 48s, wired to an audioTrack filename that never existed. THE LYRIC LINES BELOW ARE NO LONGER PLACEHOLDER: they are the song as sung, transcribed from Sérgio's own line-timed lyric file (…/Trials Songs/Infomercial/discover_the_new_you_infomercial (line).txt), and every `at` IS that file's timing to the centisecond — so the file is now a caption track, not a script, and MUST be re-derived from the lyric files (never hand-nudged) if the song is ever re-rendered. `words` (chorus scenes only) comes from the companion WORD-timed file and drives the karaoke ball per sung word. The paraphrases this replaces are gone, including the invented 'brighter, lighter, good as true' (the song says 'It's a brighter, lighter way') — the old top-level `karaoke` string that carried it is deleted, since each chorus scene now carries its own sung line. ORDER FIX: 'Three easy payments of yourself' (88.25) precedes 'Operators of grace are standing by' (91.70); the old build had them reversed. Copy still uncleared by Sérgio: `cta`, `phone`, `ministry`, `brand`, `timestamp`, `breakNoticeText`, `mediaClosedTag`, the witness lines, and the 108.60 disclaimer (the one line the SONG does not carry — the audio guide §7d keeps the disclaimer out of the song deliberately, so it stays screen-only fine print).
_docS51_break: S51 — THE BREAK NOW FIRES ON THE MUSIC. The song's last three lines are 'Call now' at 100.30 / 100.60 / 105.32 — the triple the staging has always described ('the triple Call now! loops and warps'), written into the music. `break: true` marks where the degradation starts and the CTA card freezes; `tear: true` marks where the signal tears to static. Both are FLAGS, not seconds, and the player derives its whole break choreography from them (netvision.ts's old rule — 'the break begins at the second-to-last scene' — survives only as a fallback for data with no flag). The three call scenes double as the stutter's re-fire beats, so the on-screen loop stutters when the voice does. Nothing here is per-frame scripted; noise density, tracking bands and the freeze remain a build-time judgment call.
_docS62_break: S62 — THE LAST 'Call now' NO LONGER CUTS TO DARK (Sérgio: 'the dark screen with noise is a bit too early… it also feels like a missed opportunity for some ridiculousness'). `tear` has moved OFF 105.32 onto its own beat at 107.60; 105.32 now carries `overdrive`, and for those 2.3 seconds the offer screen over-sells itself into collapse — the rosette spins, badges multiply and stack, the number stutters and duplicates across the frame, ORDER NOW! grows until it no longer fits inside the picture. THEN the tear. The break stops being a cut and becomes something the pitch does to itself, which is the tone law working exactly as written: the satire lives inside the seller's self-presentation and it collapses under its own promise. Also here: the old 97.60 `crowd` scene is RETIRED — a bare three-figure shot wedged between two blue offer screens, which Sérgio read as a jarring visual jump. The run now stays on the offer field and the phone number SWELLS into the countdown (`swell`), his own suggestion, so nothing cuts between 91.70 and the break. The 108.60 disclaimer's `at` is UNCHANGED — its timing against the ending 'Call now' is the thing he explicitly loves.

_sourceNote.text: The New You infomercial combines the MESSAGE of the 1998 "Truth in Love" ex-gay advertising campaign (principally print — first full-page ad, New York Times, 13 July 1998) with the FORMAT of prosperity-television such as Robert Tilton's Success-N-Life (testimony, direct address, repeated fundraising appeals). Truth in Love was a newspaper campaign, not a TV infomercial; Success-N-Life supplies the format only, and it was never a conversion program. The combination is an authorial design choice, not a historical claim.

_docS62_cast: S62 (2026-07-28) — THE INFOMERCIAL GETS A CAST, per docs/REINTERP_NEW_YOU_EDIT_NOTES_2026-07-28.md. Sérgio, listening to the render: the song sings in at least four voices and this file credited PASTOR DALE for lines a woman sings. Corrected here against his table — 5.92 is THE STRUGGLER (the one being addressed, not the authority); 17.16, 41.65, the three steps and both homecoming lines are THE COUNSELLOR. ⚑ THE DRAMATURGY THIS PROTECTS: the woman's voice carries 'Confess it / Submit it / Let us hold it for you' AND 'the self he meant you to be' — the softest voice makes the actual demands. Nothing in the fiction ever remarks on it; it is legible because her chyron is the one standing under the steps card. `CROWD` is renamed `THE CONGREGATION` (chyron still empty, so the chorus Sérgio loves is visually untouched). Every name is INVENTED and every line of new copy is PLACEHOLDER-draft.
_docS62_tags: S62 — THE DRTV CHYRON LAYER (Sérgio: the bodies need 'messages on the screen to add layers of interpretation'). These four captions are not invented furniture: they are what real direct-response television is legally obliged to put on screen, and DRAMATIZATION standing under a testimony is the most damning caption the era supplies — the apparatus retracts its own witness in 6pt type. Scenes reference these by key so the wording is edited in one place.

_docS63_chorus: S63 (2026-07-28) — THE CHORUS, REBUILT AROUND THE KARAOKE. Sérgio revised his own earlier positive once the rest of the film had bodies: 'it is a bit bare-bones compared to the other images now… Do you think it would be possible to keep the Karaoke aspect and just change what is being shown? Because it's almost 20 seconds of just the same background.' The bar, the red ball and every timing are untouched — only what plays behind them changed (src/desktop/apps/netvision.ts, drawChorusSet). Nothing new is authored here except `singAlong`: the congregation's growth, its convergence into one identical posture, the rising light and the kept empty place are all derived from these six scenes' own `at` values. PLACEHOLDER-draft.
_docS62_title: S62 — THE OPENING (0 → 5.92 was empty screen). An EVANGELIST Lamby, not the Clippy lamb: a haloed ministry logo in a gold-edged oval, then the title played completely straight. Sérgio's own phrase was 'recover/succumb'; the joke is that they are interchangeable, and it is deliberately NOT winked at here — the word that curdles is the one the audience supplies later. Every glitch belongs to the break.

_docS62_product: S62 — PRODUCT PLACEMENT at 33.43 ('Then Pastor Dale showed me the program'), per Sérgio: 'almost needs a fake poster of the program like a product placement.' The apparatus as a thing you can own, held up to camera the way DRTV always holds it.
_docS62_operators: S62 — 'Operators of grace are standing by' (91.70) gets a period phone in outline with its hold light blinking on the beat. The counter ticks DOWN and never reaches zero — scarcity that never resolves, which is the whole grammar of the call-now clock. The sequence is authored here rather than computed so it never lands on 0.
_doc_break: R28-2d-iv (Session 35): THE BREAK — near the video's end the tape degrades (noise density climbs, tracking bands roll, the CTA visually loops/stutters, the last portrait freezes), then tears to static; through the static, one line renders — a first crack of Caleb's message (S2R.3/S2R.5, still gated/unbuilt as its own thread — this is only the fragment surfacing, never the full message). `breakStutter` replaces the spoken line during the loop choreography; `breakNoticeText` is what renders through the static; `mediaClosedTag` is the file label named in the build brief. All PLACEHOLDER, felt-adjacent per the brief's instruction to keep it bare.
_doc_seals: S60 — THE OFFER SCREEN'S APPARATUS OF TRUST, per Sérgio's reference (a late-night DRTV end-frame: guarantee rosette, card badges, delivery fine print, ORDER NOW!, a phone number and a website). Why it is more than dressing: it puts 'three easy payments of yourself' into its native visual grammar, and a MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE ON SELFHOOD is the single most damning object the era can put on screen. The satire lives entirely inside the seller's self-presentation, exactly as the tone law requires, and it collapses under its own promise. ⚑ ETHICS: his reference shows REAL card brands (Visa/Mastercard/AmEx/Discover). Every badge below is INVENTED — no real mark, logo or likeness appears in the fiction (CLAUDE.md). All PLACEHOLDER-draft copy pending Sérgio's pass.
